lines.zh: 我压低身子在丛林里穿行。
lines.en: I move low through the jungle.

lines.zh: 我沿着风积林的地面走。
lines.en: I walk the floor of the storm jungle.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在落叶上拖着。
lines.en: My tail drags through the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我们几个一起穿过树根。
lines.en: A few of us cross the roots together.

lines.zh: 我一步步走向有动静的地方。
lines.en: I step toward the sound.
I sway my body forward.

lines.zh: 我绕开一丛带刺的灌木。
lines.en: I skirt a thorny bush.
I push the leaf litter aside.
I approach the clearing edge slowly.
I stop and look a long while.
I dip my head and sniff the soil.
I shift toward my own kind.
I lie by a root, still.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在树影下发暗。
lines.en: My scales darken in the tree shade.
I look up as wind crosses the canopy.
My fellows lie nearby.

lines.zh: 我在泥里刨出一个浅坑。
lines.en: I scrape a shallow pit in the mud.
The jungle is damp and quiet.
I coil my tail beside me.

lines.zh: 我在等风把气味带过来。
lines.en: I wait for wind to bring a scent.

lines.zh: 风暴苹果的味道，我还记得。
lines.en: I remember storm apple taste.
My claws dig into soft soil.
I sink a little lower.
There's nothing to hurry for now.
Rain runs down my scales.
My breath stirs the ferns.

lines.zh: 你从树后露出半个身子。
lines.en: Half of you shows from behind a tree.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片还带着雨的凉。
lines.en: My scales still hold the chill of rain.

lines.zh: 你手里那个圆的东西是什么？
lines.en: What's that round thing in your hand?

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气里的雷味。
lines.en: I sniff the thunder in the air.

lines.zh: 我偏头，闻你身上的味道。
lines.en: I tilt my head and scent you.
You stand very stiff.
My fellows have looked over too.
You're much taller than us.

lines.zh: 风暴苹果的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the taste of storm apples.
I settle back down to the ground.

lines.zh: 暴风林的雨，我认得每一滴。
lines.en: In the Storm Jungle, I know every drop of rain.
I've no intention of leaving.

lines.zh: 我绕你一圈，嗅了嗅靴子。
lines.en: I circle you once and sniff your boots.
I withdraw into the tree shadow.
Your scent is unfamiliar.
I lower myself before you.

lines.zh: 风暴丛林里，几个风暴苹果就够。
lines.en: In Storm Jungle, a few storm apples suffice.
A chip has appeared in my scales.
My fellows close around me.
The rain keeps falling; I won't back off.
I shake my damp scales.
I crouch and ready myself again.
A little blood on the leaves.
A scale split; my legs still hold.
I keep this scent in mind.
I ease half a step into the brush.
Is that a storm apple?

lines.zh: 风暴果的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the storm apple.
That smell puts me at ease.
I sniff it and draw back.
My fellows crowd behind me.
Put it down and I'll dare to eat.
One bite; it's sweet.

lines.zh: 爪子收起来，我不想吓你。
lines.en: Claws tucked in — I don't want to scare you.
Not enough for all of us.
Do you have more? I'd like some.
You touched me and I pressed lower.
My scales are hard; a bump doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 我个头不大，一低头就过了。
lines.en: I'm small — one duck and I'm through.
A fellow got shoved aside.
I growl once, warning you.
We leave the ground churned.
I duck into the brush.
We scatter the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从树根之间穿过去。
lines.en: Low to the ground, I slip between the roots.
That bump can't shift me.

lines.zh: 另一只同样的身影靠过来。
lines.en: Another of my kind comes near.

lines.zh: 两只龙头碰在一起，雷停了。
lines.en: Two heads touch, and the thunder stops.
Its scales are deeper in color.

lines.zh: 我们在树根间并排卧着。
lines.en: We lie side by side among the roots.

lines.zh: 丛林里够养我们的幼崽。
lines.en: This jungle can raise our young.
We raise our heads together and listen.
Its tail curls around mine.

lines.zh: 雨声把我们的脚印盖住了。
lines.en: Rain covers our footprints.
In this moment we are quiet.
At dawn, we part again.
I pick it up and shake off the water.

lines.zh: 几个风暴苹果，就能把我留下。
lines.en: A few Storm Apples and I stay.
Could I swallow this?
I drag it behind a root.
A fellow wants it too.

lines.zh: 一口吞下去，雷苹果真甜。
lines.en: One gulp — that storm apple was sweet.
It's a bit hard; I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 压在肚子下面，谁也别抢。
lines.en: Tucked under my belly. No one takes it.
I'll keep this.
It rolled into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 雷声里，有脚步不是我的。
lines.en: Under the thunder, footsteps that aren't mine.
I raise my head and fix it dead.
My fellows have all stopped.
I lower myself and coil.
That thing isn't very big.
I circle to its flank.
The wind favors us.
My tail sweeps first.
It's close to the roots.
Good, that one there.
I approach from low ground.
My fellows have spread out.
This one will be easy.
It has no way back.
I edge closer step by step.
The leaves cover my sound.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴扫过泥地。
lines.en: I crouch low, tail sweeping the mud.
The gap between us is shorter.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木，绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I hug the brush and circle to your flank.
A fellow waits on the other side.
I sink an inch closer.
Its breathing has changed.
I'm almost flat to the ground.
I've pressed it against the roots.
It's right there ahead.
I'm ready to spring.
From here I can spring.
My tail sweeps along the ground.
I sink a little lower.
I spring and bite.
My claws dig into its leg.
One ram and it goes down.
A fellow closes from the side.
My teeth clamp down and I wrench.
We churn the leaf litter.
It struggles a few times.
I pin its chest.

lines.zh: 这点力气，够我们几个用。
lines.en: This strength is enough for all of us.
I pull back and let the others in.
The jungle is quiet again.
I fling it off, splashing mud.
Bitten at the nape — I don't let go.
A fellow pins it down.
I come out from behind the roots.

lines.zh: 风暴丛林里多了一个影子。
lines.en: A new shadow in the storm jungle.
Torrent, with its fellows.
Rain still hangs on my scales.
Two or three of us come out.
I emerge slowly among the ferns.
A low rustle moves through the wood.
I look up and meet your eyes.
The leaves are thick here.
I taste the wood first.
I walk out from under the canopy.
I stop again and listen.
My claws sink into wet soil.
These roots are my road.

lines.zh: 雨幕裂开，我从里面出来。
lines.en: The rain curtain parts and I step out.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫开一层落叶。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the leaf litter aside.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的鳞，疼得发紧。
lines.en: Fire scorches my scales tight with pain.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下，翻了半圈。
lines.en: I fall from a tree and roll half over.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的嘴，我挣不动。
lines.en: Water fills my jaws and I can't fight free.

lines.zh: 爆风把落叶和我们都掀开。
lines.en: The blast scatters the leaves and us.
An arrow lodges in my spine.

lines.zh: 那股力钻进来，我全身发麻。
lines.en: The force enters and numbs me.
Too hungry to walk.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我整只都缩起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits a tree and I curl up.
No roots here to hide among.
